notes.title: Planes, Bullets and Vodka - Major Update (new languages, polish, achievements)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27140201/bd584d047a4846cedaaa978d642417f5e7629650.gif

Hello friends, happy new year I hope you all had great holidays! I'm very excited for 2024, and plan to have a very productive year!

And here is my first delivery, I just updated Planes Bullets and Vodka, to add support to new languages, a few graphical and gameplay tweaks, and more, I'll detail it all below:

New Languages Support
The main goal of this update is to make the game more accessible to people all around the world, heres the languages added to this update:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27140201/9606ce00fda600d709f1b2e06890158c9068ce6b.gif
 Spanish
 Japanese
 Traditional Chinese
 Korean
 Italian
 French
 Portuguese-PT
 Czech
 Polish
 Turkish
 Ukranian
 Thai
 Persian
 Hungarian
 Dutch 

The list was decided based on the most commom languages used on Steam. 

Gameplay and graphics update
 Menus remade, to improve navigation.
 A few sprite tweaks, to have better visibility
 A more clear display of the background colors.

Achievements
 Changed the "Destroyer" achievement from 500 to 300 enemies destroyed in a single run.
 Changed the "That's a lot of points!" achievement from 250k to 150k points in a single run.
 Changed the "I love the smell of vodka in the morning" from 10k to 3k enemies destroyed in total.

As aways thank you for your continued support, and if possible I would like to ask you to check it out Burning Skies, wich is a culmination of all this years doing arcade games, (it will be an arcade/roguelike shmup), and if you like it, please wishlist the game. 
This is the most important thing to show Steam that people are interested in the game and made it visible to more player. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915690/Burning_Skies/

notes.title: Burning Skies Arcade - Demo Update
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/7243354/040b707d40275c5971df644db46612103b8b95ef.gif

Hello folks, based on your feedback I've worked for the last weeks, on an update for the Burning Skies Arcade Demo, here's what changed:

Improvements/Fetures
 Highscore
 Saving the settings and Hiscore
 A little tutorial at the beggining of the demo
 Feedback when the player picks a power up
 Ajusted audio mastering
New Content
 New Range Power Up
Balancing
 Adjusted the space between projectiles on one of the boss's attacks
Bugfixes
- Wall creation with missing parts
- Audio didn't set to zero
- Glitch when music interlapping
- glitch engine sfx interlapping
- when pausing at the beggining the menu whould not show up
 
Check the free demo here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290190/Burning_Skies_Arcade/

As aways, thanks for your support, and please join our discord and tell me what do you think of this new update.

Burning Skies Arcade is a freeware version of Burning Skies, a bigger roguelite shmup that we'll release next year, please wishlist it so you'll receive updates when we have any news

notes.title: Cyberhunt MASSIVE UPDATE.
notes.notes:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/70a6c68e45527e58b17eb9882f1193eaf1382f53.gif
Hello friends, I have been silent for the past few months, and the reason for that is that I was making a huge update to CYBERHUNT, I basically remade it from the ground up. 
 Changed the game engine
 All graphics remade
 New missions system
 Enemies IA remade and added 2 new enemies (tank and missile)
 Controls improved and modernized
 New SFX
 and A LOT MORE... 
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/cc897322bf3be83f5a06389364af52f19618cf1c.gif
In case you prefer, you can also access the original version of CYBERHUNT by selecting the option when launching the game. 

I choose to release this as a update and not as a sequel to thank you all for all the support and give some back to the communty that gave me so much!
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/15171fc99f2047ac411bb1ad47fa1b13a46ea3c8.gif
Please let me know if you enjoyed this update, it took a lot of time and work to make it, maybe I'll do something like this with another of my titles if I feel that you guys liked.

My newest game is on sale right now, for the lowest price EVER, please check it out. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1143900/Shapeshooter/
As aways thank you very much for all the support.
Paulo

notes.title: Polygoneer FREE + Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/980fae71b7c0d1964e524831fdb157ad091ab4c9.gif

Hello friends, with giveaway of POLYGONEER the playerbase of the game has grown exponentially and some of the new players reported dificulties to play the game with different keyboard layouts. So I updated the game following this requests:

- Support to QWERTY, QWERTZ and AZERTY layouts (just acces the config on the options menu)
- 10 Options to change the sensitivity that the turret rotates (default is 5) 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/a805c1949ae29753010a97cc2879a97f3b44f008.jpg

The game can still be downloaded for free for the next two weeks so let your friends know

https://store.steampowered.com/app/684680/Polygoneer/

I'm also working on a new and bigger game, It would be great if you guys could check it out and add to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052650/Razortron_2084/
Paulo Brunassi
Please follow my developer's Steam Page

notes.title: Big update - Ver. 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello friends, it's been awhile since the last update, and 2017 its been an awesome year, 2 new games released so far here on steam, and a new one coming soon.

But apart of that, I just uploaded a new update for Planes, Bullets and Vodka and its a big one this time, here goes:

Major changes/fixes:
Leaderboards implemented
Vodka (yes, a vodka item \o)
A bigger saturation range options (image below)
Changed the behavior of the power Ups 
Changed the power ups spawn ratio and the power up selection algorithm
Added a tutorial
A new trailer for the soundtrack (get yours for free)
Joystick vibration
Updated the store descriptions and added german language to the store

Minor changes/fixes
Player weren't able to return to the title screen while paused using keyboard or joystick
The menu music didn't plays
The music "Forbidden Beat"didnt play ingame (the trailer music)
Player weren't able to set the volumes to zero (mute)
Screenshake didn't worked well while shooting

The new saturation range mentioned:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27140201/9f95b827c9701d8e75bf4e4895d11f85bc4c3e40.png

If you enjoyed the game, please leave a positive feedback, it helps A LOT for a small dev like myself.

Check out my new game Polygoneer:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/684680/Polygoneer/

Follow me on twitter for more updates on what I'm doing:
https://twitter.com/ThisIsNuk
